npc.a_bearded_woman.greet_msg_1: GET ME OUT OF HERE! NOW!
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_1:
In a just world, I would be captain of a grand ship, ... \z
	Those pirates out there would now be my minions, and we would brave the seas and become the terror of the coastal towns! ... \z
	If only our plan had worked!
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_2:
Captain Kid sold his ship to buy pointless things like those insanely expensive locks for the cell doors. ... \z
	He said the canoes would do for a while. ... \z
	I got the impression he was not overly sad to part with the ship because he was known to suffer a lot from seasickness.
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_3:
I'd have been a much better captain then Kid was. I played several captains on stage and I was good! ... \z
	Where Kid longed for the appreciation of his men, I would rule by fear and with an iron fist!
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_4:
It was all captain Kid's idea. You see, he hated his name and planned to become known by the name captain Kidnap. ... \z
	All he needed was someone famous to kidnap. ... \z
	Given his men's dismal lack of talent and intelligence that would have been quite a feat. ... \z
	We knew each other from a few scams we did together in the past, so he contacted me. ... \z
	I was to impersonate the famous Princess Lumelia. You know, the one everyone was looking for. ... \z
	That would show his men and the other pirates what a great kidnapper he was. ... \z
	He promised me that I would become his second in command and lead a wonderful life of plundering, robbing and pillaging. ... \z
	So I agreed to impersonate the Princess for a while and it worked fine at first. ... \z
	He returned with me dressed as the Princess from a raid on his own and was instantaneously the hero of the day for his men. ... \z
	Things went bad when they decided to have a victory party. ... \z
	As far as I could make out from the mumblings of the pirates, Kid lost the key to my cell while relieving himself in the underground river. ... \z
	The fool decided to dive after it .. never to be seen again. ... \z
	When I found out about Kid's demise I tried to convince the pirates it was a hoax, but they just won't believe me!
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_5:
Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you're not on the receiving end. ... \z
	It's easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can't fight back!
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_6:
The more stupid the people are, the easier it is to con them. ... \z
	And the poorer they are the less means they have to get revenge. Har Har! ... \z
	So I make sure I ruin those I scam. Then they have other things to worry about than getting revenge on me.
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_7:
The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! ... \z
	If that stupid Kid hadn't been so obsessed with kidnapping he'd not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_8:
As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! ... \z
	As soon as I get out of here I'll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don't need Captain Kid!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_1: I am a MAN! Get me out you drunken fools!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_3: Get me out! It was all part of the plan, you fools!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_4: If I ever get out of here, I'll kill you all! All of you!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_5: I am NOT Princess Lumelia, you fools!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_6: Get a locksmith and free me or you will regret it, you foolish pirates!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_7: I am not a princess, I am an actor!

npc.al_dee.stdmod_12: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?

npc.al_dee.stdmod_18: One day I will return to the continent as a rich, a very rich man!

npc.alkestios.farewell_msg_1: May your path always be even.
npc.alkestios.greet_msg_1: Nature's blessing, traveller! May you not be affected by any sinister force.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_1: Outside of our secret {realm} my siblings and I can't keep our true shape. If we want to travel other parts of the world, we must take over the bodies of animals. But we are causing them no harm and we just take control if necessary.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_2: We call it Feyrist and it is a secret, hidden place. Just few mortals get permission to enter it. A long time ago, we learned how to hide our realm from the outside world. Only if you gain our trust I will tell you how to reach it.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_3: We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
npc.alkestios.stdmod_4: We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
npc.alkestios.stdmod_5: I can sense a kind of dark energy lately. It is pervading this world, more and more every day. Yet I don't know where it arises from nor what we could do to dispel it.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_6: It is rather subversive, so most creatures won't sense it ... yet. But its corrosive power has already begun to affect my kind and our hidden realm in unpleasant ways.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_7:
Some call us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the term fae. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to protect our home. ... \z
	We tend to be secretive about our true nature, but I guess there was once an elven sage who visited our realm and put his experiences down on paper. There might be a book about the fae in the library of Ab'Dendriel.
npc.alkestios.walkaway_msg_1: May your path always be even.
npc.altar.greet_msg_1: Kneel before the all-devouring power of blooded decay.

npc.amber.greet_msg_1: Oh hello, nice to see you |PLAYERNAME|. Are you here to hear some stories of my {adventures} or do you need {help}?
npc.amber.stdmod_1: I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
npc.amber.stdmod_10: My voyage on the sea was exhausting. The weather was bad, the waves high and my raft quite simple. There's a certain excitement to it, though.
npc.amber.stdmod_11: Sorry, I lost my watch in a storm.
npc.amber.stdmod_12: Well, I can give you general {hints} or tell you about my {adventures} and many other topics. Oh, and if you are bored, I might have a small {quest} for you.
npc.amber.stdmod_13: Well, I can give you general {hints} or tell you about my {adventures} and many other topics. Oh, and if you are bored, I might have a small {quest} for you.
npc.amber.stdmod_14: I had no time to explore the dungeons of this isle yet, but I've seen two big caves in the East, and there is a ruined tower to the north-west. Oh, and there're the {sewers}.
npc.amber.stdmod_15: I like sewers. I made my very first battle experience in the sewers below {Thais}. The small sewer system of {Rookgaard} has some nasty rats to fight.
npc.amber.stdmod_16: Oh, I fought {orcs}, {cyclopses}, {minotaurs}, even {dragons}, and many other creatures.
npc.amber.stdmod_17: I don't like the way they look at you. Their eye seems to pierce right through you. Creepy!
npc.amber.stdmod_18: Their breath is so hot! I had to cut my hair after my last encounter with a dragon because the ends were all burnt. That's what you gotta deal with as a female adventurer!
npc.amber.stdmod_19: I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private {notebook} on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
npc.amber.stdmod_2: Wow, I'm tired. I really should get some sleep... zzzz.
npc.amber.stdmod_20: I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private {notebook} on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
npc.amber.stdmod_21: I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private {notebook} on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
npc.amber.stdmod_22: I think this poor guy was a bad choice as head of the {academy}.
npc.amber.stdmod_23: A fine institution, but it needs definitely more funds from the {king}.
npc.amber.stdmod_24: King Tibianus is the ruler of {Thais}. The island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
npc.amber.stdmod_25: A fine city, but the {king} has some problems enforcing the law.
npc.amber.stdmod_26: The best weapons on this isle are just toothpicks compared with the weapons warriors wield on the {mainland}.
npc.amber.stdmod_27: Spells are only taught in the guildhalls of the mainland.
npc.amber.stdmod_28: I'm trying to explore each spot of Tibia, and one day I'll have seen it all.
npc.amber.stdmod_29: If you travel to Thais, you really should visit the marvelous castle there.
npc.amber.stdmod_3: What was that word again in Orcish language... hmm.
npc.amber.stdmod_30: You'll be surprised once you leave this island. The world outside there is gigantic.
npc.amber.stdmod_31: The most important tools you need are a {rope}, a {shovel} and maybe a {torch}.
npc.amber.stdmod_32: One day I fell into a hole without having a rope. I was yelling for help for three whole days! Eventually a fisherman passed by and pulled me out with his own rope, lucky me.
npc.amber.stdmod_33: Sometimes I have the strong urge to use it to knock someone out.
npc.amber.stdmod_34: You know, on mainland you will be able to cast magic spells which provide you with light. You won't really need torches anymore.
npc.amber.stdmod_35: I have almost no money with me anyway, so no need to deposit any at the bank.
npc.amber.stdmod_36: You will find your destiny. I'm sure it's something big and important.
npc.amber.stdmod_37: A fine institution, but it needs definitely more funds from the {king}.
npc.amber.stdmod_38: Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in buying or selling anything.
npc.amber.stdmod_39: I wouldn't want to miss being a premium adventurer. Everything is so much easier!
npc.amber.stdmod_4: Hey you! Are you an adventurer, too?
npc.amber.stdmod_40: I don't have much to say about him. I think he sells {tools}.
npc.amber.stdmod_42: She seriously asked me if she could have the remains of my {raft} as fire wood! Can you imagine that??
npc.amber.stdmod_44: Did you know my name is also the name of a gem?
npc.amber.stdmod_45: To me he seems a bit rude, but maybe that's just my impression.
npc.amber.stdmod_46: I heard her offers are extraordinarily good.
npc.amber.stdmod_47: The oracle is said to show you your {destiny} once you are level 8.
npc.amber.stdmod_48: She has changed a lot since I last saw her.
npc.amber.stdmod_49: I think this poor guy was a bad choice as head of the {academy}.
npc.amber.stdmod_5: <sings> Stormy weathers, stormy weathers... stormy weathers on the sea!
npc.amber.stdmod_50: Hm, I think I haven't met her yet.
npc.amber.stdmod_51: He brought me some of his famous rat stew. I really didn't want to insult him, but I simply can't eat something like that. So I told him I'm a vegetarian and I only eat fish. <gulps>
npc.amber.stdmod_52: He's funny in his own way.
npc.amber.stdmod_53: No, I didn't go to the {bank} yet.
npc.amber.stdmod_54: A gentle person. You should visit him if you have questions or need healing.
npc.amber.stdmod_55: Hyacinth is a great healer. He lives somewhere hidden on this isle.
npc.amber.stdmod_57: I don't really know her, but she seems to be a nice girl.
npc.amber.stdmod_58: An extraordinary warrior. He's the first and last line of defense of {Rookgaard}.
npc.amber.stdmod_59: Not the nicest guys you can encounter. I had some clashes with them and finally ended up being their {prisoner} for a few months.
npc.amber.stdmod_60: I speak some Orcish words, not many though, just a few basics like '{yes}' and '{no}'.
npc.amber.stdmod_61: It's 'mok' in Orcish. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
npc.amber.stdmod_62: In Orcish that's 'burp'. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
npc.amber.stdmod_63: My favorite dish is {salmon}. Oh please, bring me some.
npc.amber.stdmod_64: Yeah! If you give me some salmon, I'll tell you another Orcish word. Okay?
npc.amber.stdmod_9: I fought fierce {monsters}, climbed the highest mountains, explored the deepest {dungeons} and crossed the {sea} on a {raft}.
npc.amber.voice_1: I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
npc.amber.voice_2: Wow, I'm tired. I really should get some sleep... zzzz.

npc.anderson.greet_msg_1: Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the Nordic Tibia Ferries. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.anderson.stdmod_2: Do you want a passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.anderson.stdmod_5: Where do you want to go today? We serve the routes to Senja, {Folda} and {Vega} and back to {Tibia}.
npc.anderson.voice_1: Passages to Tibia, Folda and Vega.
npc.andrew_lyze.greet_msg_1: Hello, I am the warden of this {monument}. The {sarcophagus} in front of you was established to prevent people from going {down} there. But I doubt that this step is sufficient.
npc.andrew_lyze.greet_msg_2: Well, let's see if your mission was successful. Just bring me all needed {materials}.
npc.andrew_lyze.greet_msg_3: If you dug up all three crystals of sufficient quantity and obtained the poison gland, the charging of your compass can start! For the very first time it will be charged by the violet crystal. Ready to {unleash} the power of the crystals?
npc.anerui.stdmod_1: I am the mistress of the hunt. At this place you may buy the food our hunts provide.
npc.anerui.stdmod_10: The balance of nature, of course. It's everywhere, so don't ask but observe and learn.
npc.anerui.stdmod_11: We try to live in harmony with the forces of nature, may they be living or unliving.
npc.anerui.stdmod_12: The humans are a loud and ugly race. They lack any grace and are more kin to the orcs then to us.
npc.anerui.stdmod_13: Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
npc.anerui.stdmod_14: Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
npc.anerui.stdmod_15: I despise their presence in our town, but it may be a necessary evil.
npc.anerui.stdmod_16: That is the race to which I belong.
npc.anerui.stdmod_17: The magic they wield is all that matters to them.
npc.anerui.stdmod_2: Hunting is an art, practiced too often by diletantes. Every fool with a bow or a spear considers himself a hunter.
npc.anerui.stdmod_3: Bow, arrow, and spear are the hunters' best friends. In the northeast of the town one of us may sell such tools.
npc.anerui.stdmod_4: Hunters live a life of freedom and closeness to nature, unlike a simple farmer or bugherder.
npc.anerui.stdmod_5: Nature is not a friend but an unforgiving teacher, and the lessons we have to learn are endless.
npc.anerui.stdmod_6: Watch the sky, it will tell you.
npc.anerui.stdmod_7: I guess it's a human god for the human sight of nature. I have not much knowledge of this entity.
npc.anerui.stdmod_8: If they ever existed they are gone now.
npc.anerui.stdmod_9: The Kuridai are too agressive not only to people but also to the enviroment. They lack any understanding of the balance that we know as nature.
npc.aneus.farewell_msg_1: Good bye and take care of you!
npc.aneus.greet_msg_1: Greetings adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. What leads you to me?
npc.aneus.stdmod_1: It was the elite of the whole army. They were called the Red Legion (also known as the bloody legion).
npc.aneus.stdmod_2: The orcs attacked the workers from time to time and so they disturbed the WORKS on the city.
npc.aneus.stdmod_3: The soldiers treated the workers like slaves.
npc.aneus.stdmod_4: The General of the Red Legion became very angry about these attacks and after some months he STROKE back!

npc.angelina.greet_msg_2: Thanks for saving my life! Should I teleport you out of the Dark Cathedral?

npc.azalea.stdmod_25:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

npc.azalea.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.azalea.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.barazbaz.say_1: Ancient structures in the sewers you say? Well, our city has had a certain bloody past, even before it has been city at all. But to investigate the archives for what you may have found is a time-consuming process. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_10: Something like the ruins you have found. What you have seen there hints to a new incident, though. As if someone or something was searching for something. In the past, when those ruins were buried, people were primitive and superstitious. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_11: Today, we have advanced far more and could have the ruins investigated in a far more efficient way. And that is what I would just recommend you to do: get a necrometer from magistrate Jondrin upstairs and investigate the ruins thoroughly.
npc.barazbaz.say_12: I know that handwriting you describe! It belongs to a traveller from far away. Magistrate Sholley introduced him to me and she was quite excited to learn more about our city's past. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_13: I should have thought of him right in the beginning when I heard the stuff you mentioned. But I haven't seen him for a while. You should ask Sholley about her friend to learn about his whereabouts.
npc.barazbaz.say_2: Usually, I'm too much bound to my duties to the city to sacrifice time for such an endeavour. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_3: But on the other hand, just now is the time of an important decision of the magistrate concerning the funding of the archives. It is a matter easily overlooked by our good citizens. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_4: If you'd be so kind to place just one of your votes for the funding of the archives, I would be inclined to take the time for your investigation in turn. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_5: Just go to Marvin in the magistrate and vote for a greater funding of the archives. Afterwards, I might be able to present you with some first results of my investigations on your behalf.
npc.barazbaz.say_6: Excellent! Concerning the ancient ruins that you have found, well, if you are not familiar with the city's history, feel free to browse a few books here. I will only refer to some basics here, so I don't waste your time. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_7: The first humans that lived here and that we have any records of lived in slavery of an ancient evil. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_8: The nature of this evil is up to debate, but there are hints that this evil predated the settlement of men and that it perhaps was part of a more ancient civilisation or caused the downfall of the latter. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_9: After that evil had been overcome, much was sealed away. Some say that only forbidden knowledge had been sealed, but others like me were always worried that more had been hidden. ...

npc.bozo.mission_30_t3_1: Great! That's the word of a true fool! Maybe you want to write the names down. Here we go: Deliver a cookie to: ...
npc.bozo.mission_30_t3_2: The pompous hero Avar Tar in Edron, Simon the greedy beggar on Fibula, the pirate Ariella on the Shattered Isles, the dubious Lorbas next to the ruins of the Dark Cathedral, King Markwin in the underground city Mintwalin ...
npc.bozo.mission_30_t3_3: The shaman Hjaern on the ice island Nibelor, the witch Wyda in the Green Claw Swamp, the ape Hairycles in the jungle city Banuta ...
npc.bozo.mission_30_t3_4: The orc king in the orc fortress Uldrek's Rock and the last one to EITHER Yaman, the green djinn, OR, Nah'Bob, the blue djinn ...
npc.bozo.mission_30_t3_5: A piece of cake isn't it? Did you take notes? If you need the list again, just ask me for it. Otherwise leave now and report about the mission whenever you're done.
npc.bozo.multi_1: You shaved the emperor, but lost the beard? What kind of fool are you? Well, at least he will have a nice surprise when he wakes up ...
npc.bozo.multi_10: Are you sure you want to waste a part of your limited lifetime on a quest that makes a fool of yourself and which might award you with the prestigious title of a grand fool in a far away future?
npc.bozo.multi_2: Still, as a small recognition of your accomplishments I'm willing to tell you how to get your own jester outfit. If you are interested in more fun and adventures, ask me for more missions.
npc.bozo.multi_3: What a foolish decision! You are indeed a worthy candidate! But let's talk about business ...
npc.bozo.multi_4: Being a jester is not just about telling jokes. A good jester heavily relies on requisites ...
npc.bozo.multi_5: Getting some requisites will be your first job. First of all we need a good supply of water squirt flowers ...
npc.bozo.multi_6: I'm making them on my own in my spare time but I need the right material. South of Thais, next to the Whiteflower Temple, you will find the ideal flowers ...
npc.bozo.multi_7: Take a kitchen knife, cut the thickest and healthiest flower and bring it here. Then talk to me about your mission.
npc.bozo.multi_8: So you want to make a total fool of yourself? Fine with me, but note that becoming a real fool means more than being just an ordinary fool ...
npc.bozo.multi_9: You will have to master a whole series of challenging, lengthy and, above all, totally foolish quests ...
npc.bozo.say_1: Wow, your stupidity would be pride and joy for every fool. You've already applied as a member. Let's rather talk about your current mission.
npc.bozo.say_10: Oh boy, why do only fools apply for the fools guild?
npc.bozo.say_2: Do you wish to become a jester and join the fools guild?
npc.bozo.say_3: I'm sure it suits you well.

npc.bozo.say_5: Eeeek! What have you done?? These pies are crawling with bugs! Those must be the infamous parcel bugs! Get some new pies at once you wannabe fool, and this time without any bugs!
npc.bozo.say_6: No, you don't! Why do only fools apply for the fools guild?
npc.bozo.say_7: Too bad, I'm convinced you have it in you.
npc.bozo.say_8: You won't be successful in the fool's world with such an attitude.
npc.bozo.say_9: You wasted the disguise?? Why do only fools apply for the fools guild? Here... try again, but be wittier this time.

npc.brasith.stdmod_1: You may buy all the things we grow or gather at this place.
npc.brasith.stdmod_10: Life takes many forms. Plants are a very basic form of life. Its simplicity makes them close to the core of nature.
npc.brasith.stdmod_2: We abandoned the gods a long time ago. A short time after they abandoned us.
npc.brasith.stdmod_3: They are lost, and if they still exist they are alone in the cold and the darkness.
npc.brasith.stdmod_4: The Kuridai left the true path and can't see their error. Their way of living may have been suitable in the past, but if they don't come back to us, their path will lead into darkness.
npc.brasith.stdmod_5: We have still much to learn but we are on the correct path at least.
npc.brasith.stdmod_6: The Cenath forgot as many as they learned. I doubt they find the wisdom they are looking for without the things they neglected in their pursuit of knowledge.
npc.brasith.stdmod_7: I don't claim to understand this creatures but sometimes they are more close to the roots than we are.
npc.brasith.stdmod_8: They are so many, so planless, so divided. They choose a path I do not want for my own race.

This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z

npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_7: The 'Sea Goddess' is the most beautiful in Oramond, a whole new model of ship, elegant, sure and swift. There's no weather she can't take!
npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_8: Ah, your lands are quite a sight! I have only visited Thais so far, but I think of navigating to more cities, when the time - and public demand - comes.

npc.captain_haba.greet_msg_1: Harrr, landlubber wha'd ya want? Askin' for a {passage}?
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_1: Is this a mutiny or what? Move, move!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_10: Dis is no passenger ship it's a WARship. I'm on hunting business.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_11: Never heard of him. He is no captain that's for sure, otherwise I'd know him. I was on the sea for the last 20 years hunting this, this monster.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_12: Yee, I've been chasing that monster for over 20 years now. I promise I'll bring it down!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_13: It lets me forget the long years, the lost years. The years I was chasing after THAT monster, the sea serpent.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_15: Our last ship has been destroyed by the most evil creature of the ocean: the sea serpent. To continue our hunt, I've bought this ship here.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_17: I'm faithful - I'll catch that monster one day. Yes I will, as sure as my name is Captain Haba!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_18: On the high seas there is no queen. At least I didn't see her yet. Hararar!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_19: On the high seas there is no king. At least I didn't see him yet. Hararar!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_2: In the rigging ya lazy fools!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_20: Arms, legs, head, whatever. I got injuries on almost every part of my body!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_21: This is no shop boy, this is a warship!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_22: We aren't even near that location! Wanna swim? Harharhar!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_23: I know Marvik in Thais. He once helped me with a furuncle I had on my ...ahh, doesn't matter. He's a nice gran'pa, though!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_24: My worst enemy is a huge sea serpent. I dunno when I started to follow it's trail. I'll kill it and if it's the last thing I'll do, I'll kill it!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_3: I wanna see you movin' ya lazy fools!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_4: Full sails!! There's a sea serpent to catch!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_5: My name is Haba, Captain Haba for ya little worm.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_6: I ain't no pirate. Don't let yourself mislead by my pirate hat. I got it from a friend of mine.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_7: Most o' my friends are dead the others don't like me anymore......well, seems there aren't many left.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_8: What fo' godsake shall that be??
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_9: Who are ya calling a barbarian?!? Watch your tongue here on board or you end up as fish fodder!
npc.captain_haba.voice_1: Is this a mutiny or what? Move, move!!

npc.captain_haba_open_sea.larboard_4: LARBOARD!! THY DOES THIS TAKE SO LONG?!? LET'S GET IT ON!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.larboard_5: LET'S GO YOU LAZY FOOLS. WE GOT A SEA SERPENT TO CATCH! TO LARBOARD SIDE, GO, GO, GO!

npc.captain_haba_open_sea.starboard_5: CHANGE COURSE TO STARBOARD!! WHY DOES THIS TAKE SO LONG?!? HURRY UP!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.stdmod_1: I'd go by myself and tear that beast's heart out if I were younger. I hope ya can do that for me. Now go and good luck to ya!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.stdmod_2: Ya're a coward, aren't ya? Prove that I'm wrong and get your lazy bones up to the lookout!!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.stdmod_3: Just ask me for a trade if you need a bait.
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.stdmod_4: I can give ya a challenge to test if ya have the guts to be a real sailor. Go up to the lookout and remain there for 24 hours during a storm! Harharhar!

npc.caramellia.stdmod_2: Please leave me alone in my mourning.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_3: All is lost. With {Winfred} dead, my love has died and I'm only an empty shell without hope or purpose.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_4: We put all our hope in this far away colony. Sadly, we never made it there and I will never know what our life would have been like in Port Hope.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_5: I guess he was the one that put my father up to the whole thing. He spied on Winfred and me and it was certainly him that suggested my {imprisonment} in this tower.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_6: This forsaken place seems as remote from the rest of the world as my heart is.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_7: Please leave me alone in my mourning.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_8: The bustling streets of Thais are all but a faint memory to me.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_9: Carlin is a lovely and green city as far as I remember.
npc.caramellia.voice_1: Can I finally have some peace...?
npc.caramellia.voice_2: Please leave me alone in my mourning.
npc.carlos.greet_msg_1: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! As a tailor and merchant I have to say - we need to do something about your {outfit}, shall we?
npc.carlos.greet_msg_10: Hello again, |PLAYERNAME|! What are you still doing here? You should head over the bridge to Rookgaard village now!
npc.carlos.greet_msg_2: Hey, I thought you were going to run away, but luckily you came back. I'll show you how to change your {outfit}, okay?
npc.carlos.greet_msg_3: Welcome back! You know, after providing my little outfit service, I like to ask a little favour of you. Can you {help} me?
npc.carlos.greet_msg_4: Oh hey |PLAYERNAME|, you didn't answer my question yet - could you help me get some {food}? I'll even give you some gold for it.
npc.carlos.greet_msg_5: Welcome back |PLAYERNAME|, I hope you changed your mind and will bring me some {meat}? I'll even give you some gold for it.
npc.carlos.greet_msg_6: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Did you have a successful hunt and carry a piece of {meat} or ham with you?
npc.carlos.greet_msg_7: Welcome back, Isleth Eagonst! Do you still have that piece of meat or ham? If so, please ask me for a {trade} and I'll give you some gold for it.
npc.carlos.greet_msg_8: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Where did you put that delicious piece of food? Did you eat it yourself? Well, if you find another one, please come back.
npc.carlos.greet_msg_9: Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|! Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard! Take care!
npc.carlos.sendtrade_msg_1: Very nice! Food for me! Sell it to me, fast! Once you sold your food to me, just say {ready} to let me know you are done.
npc.carlos.voice_1: Hmm, we should do something about your outfit.
npc.carlos.voice_2: Ah, another adventurer. Let's talk a little.
npc.carlos.voice_3: Psst! Come over here for a little trade.
npc.carlos.voice_4: Hello, hello! Don't be shy, I don't bite.
npc.carlos.voice_5: By the way, if you want to look at old hints again, find the 'Help' button near your inventory and select 'Tutorial Hints'.
npc.carlos.walkaway_msg_1: Good bye traveller and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
npc.carlson.stdmod_2: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.carlson.stdmod_3: Where do you want to go? To {Folda}, {Senja} or {Tibia}?
npc.cassino.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the Cassino! Here we play with: \n [PAYOUT 180%] {HIGH / LOW}: High for 4, 5, 6 and Low for 1, 2, and 3 - {ODD / EVEN }: Odd for 1, 3, 5 and Even for 2, 4 and 6 \n [PAYOUT 500%] {NUMBERS}: You choose the number, and if you get it right ... {$$$$$}
npc.cassino.say_1: Your bet is lower than the min {{}}gps or higher than the max {{}}gps bet.
npc.cedrik.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_11: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_12: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_13: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_14: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_15: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_16: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_17: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_18: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_19: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_20: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_21: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_22: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_23: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_25:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.cedrik.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.cedrik.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.cedrik.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.ceiron.farewell_msg_1: May Crunor bless and guide you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.ceiron.greet_msg_1: Always nice to meet a fellow druid, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.ceiron.walkaway_msg_1: May Crunor bless and guide you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.cerdras.farewell_msg_1: May Crunor bless and guide you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.cerdras.stdmod_1: I'm merely a humble druid like so many others here. I may not be the most talented of healers, but I am gifted with a special atunement to the elements.
npc.cerdras.stdmod_2: For me, nature is the harmony of the elements. This harmony can be disturbed by certain events, but nature always finds its way back to harmony in the end.
npc.charles.greet_msg_1: Ahoy. Where can I sail you today?
npc.charles.stdmod_1: Passages to Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay and Yalahar.
npc.charles.stdmod_3: Do you seek a passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.charles.stdmod_4: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.charles.stdmod_5: Where do you want to go - {Thais}, {Darashia}, {Venore}, {Liberty Bay}, {Ankrahmun}, {Yalahar} or {Edron?}
npc.charles.stdmod_6: Where do you want to go - {Thais}, {Darashia}, {Venore}, {Liberty Bay}, {Ankrahmun}, {Yalahar} or {Edron?}
npc.charles.stdmod_7: Im the captain of the Poodle, the proudest ship on all oceans.
npc.charles.stdmod_8: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.charles.voice_1: Passages to Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay and Yalahar.
npc.charlotta.greet_msg_1: Ah, welcome! Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! If you need druid spells, you've come to the right place. Otherwise it's just nice to have a visitor.
npc.charos.greet_msg_1: Hello young friend! I can attune you to a city of your choice. If you step to the teleporter here you will not appear in the city you came from as usual, but the city of your choice. Is it what you wish?
npc.charos.say_1: Fine. You have {} \z attunements left. What is the new city of your choice? Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Kazordoon, Venore, \z Ankrahmun, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay or Port Hope?
npc.chartan.greet_msg_1: Great Znake forgive me to converze wiz ziz unworzy blankzkin.
npc.chavis.greet_msg_1: Hey there! You don't happen to have some {food} on you, you're willing to share? Well, where are my manners, a warm welcome for now.
npc.chavis.say_1: Hey there, just to let you know - I am not a man of many words. I prefer 'deeds', you see? The poor of this city will not feed themselves. ...
npc.chavis.say_2: So in case you've got nothing better to do - and it sure looks that way judging by how long you're already loitering around in front of my nose - please help us. ...
npc.chavis.say_3: If you can find some of the nutritious, juicy {roots} in the outskirts of Rathleton, bring them here. We will gladly take bundles of five roots each, and hey - helping us, helps you in the long term, trust me.
npc.chavis.say_4: Don't be fooled, we have here masters and servants like everywhere else. The whole system is a scam to subdue the masses, to fool them about what is really happening. ...
npc.chavis.say_5: The system only ensures that the rich have a better control and the labourers are only used.
npc.chemar.farewell_msg_1: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.chemar.stdmod_1: Ask me if you need letters or parcels. I'll deliver them via airmail, of course!
npc.chemar.stdmod_3: Never heard about a place like this.
npc.chemar.stdmod_4: Do you seek a ride to {0} for {1}?
npc.chemar.voice_1: Ask me if you need letters or parcels. I'll deliver them via airmail, of course!
npc.chemar.voice_2: Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!
npc.chemar.walkaway_msg_1: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.chester_kahs.voice_1: Too many possibilities to become a servant of darkness to trust ANYONE!
npc.chester_kahs.voice_2: Don't tell me I didn't warn you.
npc.chester_kahs.voice_3: It's all a big conspiracy, mark my words.
npc.chester_kahs.voice_4: Not everything that walks our streets is human ... or even living.
npc.chester_kahs.voice_5: We are surrounded by myths, living and dead.
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_1: Grarkharok's bestest troll tribe! Yeee, good name!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_10: Fragratosh stupid. He chief of me old tribe. No frogs, no snakes, no smashing humans withrocks. Booooooring tribe! Now me make own tribe!!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_11: Grarkharok no listen to talk of stinky human! Lalalalalala! Like song? Grarkharok made!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_12: You have what want! Go go, find lady so be Grarkharok tribe!!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_14: You say troll speak!! Hmmm, sound like south tribe! You know Ingortrak ?? He chief of big tribe in jungle! Good chief he is!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_15: I Tem?!?!? No know! Maybe YOU Tem?
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_2: Grarkharok make new tribe here! Me Chief now!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_3: Me like to throw rocks, me also like frogs! Yumyum!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_4: Me tribe in production! Only need troll lady!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_5: Me no nothing! Need all money to make Grarkharok tribe!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_6: Grarkharok like BOOM, BOOM sound! Go mountain, push rock and BOOM!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_7: Like it?? Hope troll lady also like it!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_8: Me no like human. Need quiet to make tribe! Only need troll lady!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_9: Yeye, me stole chief club from Fragratosh, hrhrhrh! Now make me own tribe!
npc.chief_grarkharok.voice_1: Grarkharok's bestest troll tribe! Yeee, good name!
npc.chief_grarkharok.voice_2: Grarkharok make new tribe here! Me Chief now!
npc.chief_grarkharok.voice_3: Me like to throw rocks, me also like frogs! Yumyum!
npc.chrystal.greet_msg_1: At your service |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the post office.
npc.chrystal.sendtrade_msg_1: Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
npc.chuckles.say_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.cipfried.greet_msg_1: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! You are looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds. It's my job after all.
npc.cipfried.greet_msg_2: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! I'll {heal} you if you are injured or poisoned. Feel free to ask me for {help} or general {hints}.
npc.cipfried.kw_ship_1: Ships are a comfortable way of travelling to distant cities. At any harbour, you can board the ship and ask its captain where he sails to.
npc.cipfried.kw_ship_2: Travelling by ship will cost you some gold, though, so be sure to have money with you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_1: Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or help!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_10: Your near destiny will be to choose a {vocation} once you are level 8. Whether you will become a {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid} is a big decision!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_11: That's where we are - the world of Tibia, in a village called {Rookgaard}, to be precise, with many {monsters}, {quests} and {citizens} around.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_12: How can I help you? I can tell you about specific {citizens} if you tell me their name. I can also give you general {hints} about {Tibia}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_13: Only a few people live in our village, most of them are {merchants}. You can either ask them for a {trade} or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their {job} or Tibia in general.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_14: I don't have any goods for trade, but if you ask one of the {merchants}, he or she will gladly show you what you can buy or sell.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_15: A single rat doesn't pose a grave danger to you, but be careful not to get cornered by many of them. They could still {kill} you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_16: If you face spiders, beware of the {poisonous} ones. If you are poisoned, you will constantly lose health. Come to me and I'll heal you from poison.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_17: If you get killed, you will revive in this temple. However, you will lose experience and also equipment, which can be quite painful. Take good care of yourself!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_18: Poison is very dangerous! Don't ever drink green liquids, they are poisonous and will make you lose health!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_19: There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each vocation has its unique special abilities.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_2: Come to me if you need healing!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_20: Knights are close combat fighters. They usually wield melee weapons such as swords, axes or clubs.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_21: Druids are nature magicians. Their speciality is casting ice and earth magic, as well as providing healing for others.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_22: Paladins are well-trained distance fighters and can cast holy magic. You will usually see them wearing bows or crossbows.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_23: Sorcerers are elemental magicians. They have mastered fire, energy and death magic.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_24: You can buy and sell goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_25: You can buy equipment from the {merchants} in this village once you earned some {gold}. Some {monsters} also carry equipment pieces with them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_26: Shovels are very useful. There may be a hidden entrance under a loose pile of stone and without a shovel, how would you know?
npc.cipfried.stdmod_27: Never go adventuring without a rope! If you don't have one when you fall through a hole in the ground, you won't be able to leave without a rope.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_28: To defend yourself against enemies, you will need a weapon. You can purchase weapons at {Obi}'s shop.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_29: Food is very important for your health. If you are hurt in a fight with a {monster}, select 'Use' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. This will slowly refill your health.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_3: Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_30: As a premium adventurer, you are an official tax payer and thus privileged in many ways. For example, you can travel by {ship} and get better deals from {merchants}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_31: Potions will come in handy once you are in a fight deep in a dungeon. If you aren't in immediate danger, you can simply eat {food} to regain health, though.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_32: The academy is just north of here. You can learn helpful things there from {Seymour}, if you wish to!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_33: Well, King Tibianus of course. The island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_34: The {gods} have chosen this isle as the point of arrival for newborn souls. The {citizens} will help you if you ask them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_35: They created {Tibia} and all life on it. Visit our {academy} and learn about them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_36: Monsters are a constant threat to this village. You would tremendously help us by fighting them, starting with {rats} in the {sewers}, then turning to {spiders} or {wolves}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_37: You can buy and sell goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_38: The sewers are right below this village. North of this temple, you find a sewer grate which leads down, but there are also many small huts in the village which are connected to the sewers.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_39: I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in worldly goods. If you want to buy or sell something, you should ask a local merchant for a trade.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_40: To defend yourself against enemies, you will need armor and shields. You can purchase both at {Dixi}'s shop.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_41: You can earn a fair amount of gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Many {citizens} are buying some of that loot, simply ask around.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_42: Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, thank you. If you are looking for something to do, you should listen to the local {citizens} and ask them for {quests}. You could also help us fight {monsters}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_43: Wolves can only be found outside of the village. If you want to know where their dens are, best talk to {Dallheim} or {Zerbrus} at the bridges.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_44: I can see a bright future for you... you will soon embark on a very big adventure and explore the world of {Tibia} - maybe even influence history!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_45: You are poisoned. I will help you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_47: You aren't looking really bad, |PLAYERNAME|. I can only help in cases of real emergencies. Raise your health simply by eating {food}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_48: Obi's {shop} is to the north-east of this humble temple. He sells {weapons}, and his granddaughter {Dixi} sells {armor} and {shields} upstairs.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_49: She recently opened a little bar north of this village.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_50: That's a sad story. He used to help me guard this temple, but for some reason he went out of his mind.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_51: I absolutely appreciate what he's doing. He has helped me a lot since he took up the job of welcoming newcomers to this island.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_52: That old lady hasn't had an easy life. Her son {Tom} completely abandoned her, but I have no idea why.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_53: In Al Dee's shop you'll find important general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and torches.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_54: Amber is such a lovely girl, and also a very experienced {explorer} and {adventurer}. It's always interesting to chat with her.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_55: He's a farmer, just like his cousin {Willie}. He doesn't talk to everybody, though.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_56: Willie is a farmer, just like his cousin {Billy}. His farm is located left of the temple. You can buy and sell {food} there.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_58: That's {Obi's} granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She helps him by selling {armor} and {shields}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_59: Hyacinth is a close friend of mine. He left the village many years ago to live in solitude. I think all this bustle here simply was too much for him.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_6: Me? Oh, I'm just a humble {monk}. Ask me if you need {help} or {healing}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_60: Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit her!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_61: You must have passed the house of Lily on your way here. She sells {potions}. If you pick blueberries or find cookies, she'll buy them from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_62: You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to find your {destiny}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_8: I have sacrificed my life to serve the good gods of {Tibia} and to help newcomers in this world.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_9: You can deposit your money at the bank. That way you won't lose it if you get {killed}. The bank is just under the academy and to the right.
npc.cipfried.voice_1: Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or help!
npc.cipfried.voice_2: Come to me if you need healing!
npc.cipfried.voice_3: Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!

npc.cledwyn.say_7: Sorry, friend, but one good turn deserves another. Bring enough {} and it's a deal.
npc.cledwyn.voice_2: Bespoke armor for all vocations! For the cost of some tokens only!
npc.coltrayne.greet_msg_1: Hey there. Need some armor or weapon? Then ask me for a {trade}.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_1: Team up with others to defeat monsters!
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_10: Good at potions. Likes experimenting. Can kit you out with magical equipment for a hunt.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_11: Gives newcomers hints how we do things here in Tibia. Don't know how to use something? Ask Inigo.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_12: Don't have much to say about him. Barely know him. Seems a decent spell teacher for mages.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_2: Get your gear and help us defend Dawnport against the monsters!
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_3: Better weapons equal more damage - get yourself some gear right here!
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_4: Gird youselves! Chain mail, bows, spears, swords - we've got it all!
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_5: Skill comes with practice - get out there and kill some beasts!
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_6: Coltrayne Daggard. Just ask me for a trade to see the latest in chain mail and weapons.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_7: I'm a blacksmith by trade. Want to keep our lads and lasses safe and equipped with a sharp blade, me.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_8: You mean to imply I am an inexperienced guardian? Get out of here.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_9: Yes. You wish to trade I guess. At least, you look like you could use some good gear, kid.
npc.coltrayne.voice_1: Team up with others to defeat monsters!
npc.coltrayne.voice_2: Get your gear and help us defend Dawnport against the monsters!
npc.coltrayne.voice_3: Better weapons equal more damage - get yourself some gear right here!
npc.coltrayne.voice_4: Gird youselves! Chain mail, bows, spears, swords - we've got it all!
npc.coltrayne.voice_5: Skill comes with practice - get out there and kill some beasts!
npc.cornelia.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the finest {armor} shop in the land, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.cornell.farewell_msg_1: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
npc.cornell.greet_msg_1: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today, to {Grimvale} or {Edron}?
npc.cornell.stdmod_2: Do you seek a passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.cornell.stdmod_3: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.corym_butler.greet_msg_1: We have to dig up valuable resources, but don't get enough to eat. The situation is terrible.
npc.corym_butler.greet_msg_2: Every man is the architect of his own fortune. The times of {repression} are finally over.
npc.corym_footman.greet_msg_1: What we get to eat is really ridiculous.
npc.corym_footman.greet_msg_2: Every man is the architect of his own fortune. We have nearly died of {hunger}.
npc.corym_ratter.greet_msg_1: We dig up all what mother earth delivers to us, valuable natural resources.
npc.corym_ratter.greet_msg_2: Welcome stranger! You might be surprised that I don't attack you immediately. The point is, that I think you could be useful to me. What you see in front of you is a great mine of the corym! ...
npc.corym_ratter.greet_msg_3: We dig up all what mother earth delivers to us, valuable natural resources. But the yield is getting worse and here I need your {help}.
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_1: Every man is the architect of his own fortune. The times of repression are finally over.
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_2: We work as hard we can, my master! Wait, I haven't seen you here before. You were sent by the Corym Ratter, I see. He misses the courage to visit us and find the reason for {decreasing resources}? He's the coward I have expected.
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_3: Well, I see you have already collected enough rare earth! Would you give it to me?
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_4: You have to liberate all the Corym I told you. Unlock the three affected areas.
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_5: Well done! The riot progesses! No fight without weapons. In the mine the temperature is quite high, higher as expected in this depth. Therefore we need heat-resistent weapons and armors. ...
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_6: This effect can be reached by adding rare earth to the common materials. But this can only be found in the stomaches of stonerefiners. 20 of these should be enough. Well, I see you have already collected enough of them! Would you give it to me?
npc.corym_slave.greet_msg_1: The repression has taken too long. With our new weapons the respective people will get their just punishment.
npc.corym_slave.greet_msg_2: Every man is the architect of his own fortune. There will be the day of {pay back}.

npc.corym_worker_01.greet_msg_2: My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend! I am poor but nevertheless I give you this as little reward.

npc.dallheim.greet_1: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.dallheim.greet_2: <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_1: The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_11: I'm the guard of this bridge. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the {wilderness} and the {dungeons}, and even of the stinking {sewers}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_12: My duty is eternal. Time is of no importance.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_13: Before you fight monsters, deposit your money there. If you die, you won't lose it if it's save in the bank.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_15: I have to stay here, sorry. But I can heal you if you are wounded. I have also valuable information about {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_16: I'm an expert concerning the wildlife and {monsters} on this island.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_17: I'll protect all citizens alike. That is my {job} and duty.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_18: Did you know that rats are among the most dangerous animals in whole Tibia? Each day, they kill many people who are overestimating their powers. Don't be one of them!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_19: There are two types of spiders on this island: normal spiders and poison spiders. As their name says, the latter ones can poison you which will cause a constant loss of your health. Beware of them!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_2: Want to know what monsters are good for you at your level? Just ask me!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_20: Once you have upgraded your starter {equipment} a little - maybe leather stuff - and got a better weapon as well as a shield, you should be able to kill trolls.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_21: You need a stronger weapon than the starter club to kill wolves. Maybe a {sabre} or a short {sword} will do.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_22: Orcs are a constant menace. There are even stronger species of orcs on the main continent.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_23: Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_24: They are a little tougher than they look like, but they're still good beginner monsters.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_25: The skeletons on this island are usually fairly hidden. They are often found near graves and always underground. Beware of their evil life drain.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_26: A bear can easily kill you if you don't pay attention.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_27: Wasps are the fastest monsters on this island and they poison you. If you ever run into one and are already low of health, fear for your life!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_28: Snakes can poison you, too, but their poison is usually not as dangerous as that of poison spiders. Just be careful and kill them fast.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_29: Premium warriors pay. They gain many advantages this way.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_3: I'll crush all monsters who dare to attack our base.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_31: All that theory won't help you without some real battle practice.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_32: A place of protection. Nothing can harm you there.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_33: I can mark you some dungeons on your map if you ask me about {monsters} suited for your level.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_34: The sewers are crowded with {rats}. They make fine targets for young heroes.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_35: There are {wolves}, {bears}, {snakes}, {deer}, and {spiders} in the wilderness past this bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_37: The heavenly warrior! Hail to him!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_38: I'm not interested in such party tricks.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_39: A nice place for a hero, but nothing for whelps.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_4: Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_40: It's my duty to protect this village and its {citizens}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_41: It looks like you have mastered the drill.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_42: Sorry, I don't trade. Ask the shop owners for a trade instead.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_43: I don't approve of her opening a bar. Those drunken adventurers stumbling over the bridge at nighttime are not especially helpful in improving the situation.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_44: Zerbrus tells me such strange stories about him. Well, he sees him all day from the west bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_45: He dedicated his life to welcoming newcomers to this island.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_47: He has been on this island as long as me.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_49: He guards the temple and can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned, just like me.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_50: She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_51: Strange fellow, hides somewhere in the mountains of the isle.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_52: Her shop is on the {premium} side of town. Best offers around.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_53: Sometimes I wish I had an easy job like her, selling {potions} all day.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_54: You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_6: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_7: <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_9: Hmm, |PLAYERNAME|. I really don't know if you should go into the wilderness without a shield. You should earn some money by hunting rats under the village first until you can afford at least a wooden shield.

npc.dedoras.stdmod_1: I need the help of some competent {adventurers} to handle a threat to all creation.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_10:
Hints about the shrouded hoard are numerous, though most are general mentions in texts that deal with Zathroth. But there are other sources. ... \z
	Like texts about ancient liturgies of Zathroth and historical documents that might give us clues. I already compiled everything of value from the sources that were openly available. ... \z
	To gather the more {obscure} parts of knowledge, however, I'll need your help.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_11:
Of course the first to ask would be the famous Avar Tar, but I heard he's already on a quest of his own and ... \z
	Well, let's say our last collaboration did not end too well. In fact, I'd be not even surprised if he pretended to not even know me. ... \z
	So I have to look elsewhere to handle this new {threat}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_12:
The parts alone do them no good. To assemble the parts, great skill, immense power and forbidden knowledge are necessary. ... \z
	The skill will be supplied by the fallen Yalahari and the power by Variphor itself. ... \z
	The only thing they are still lacking is the knowledge to assemble and operate the {godbreaker}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_13:
Of course the dangers of such knowledge were obvious. It was hidden in a sacred place devoted to Zathroth and dangerous knowledge. ... \z
	The hidden library, the forbidden hoard, the shrouded trove of knowledge or the veiled hoard of forbidden knowledge, the place has many names in many {myths}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_14:
Regardless of the dangers, the cult of Zathroth refused to destroy the knowledge of the godbreaker for good. ... \z
	They {value} dangerous knowledge that much, that they are unable to part from it, even when faced with the utter destruction of creation.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_15:
I know it's asked much but it's no longer a matter of choice. ... \z
	The enemy is moving and I have reports that suggest the minions of Variphor are actively searching for Zathroth's library. They must not be allowed to succeed. ... \z
	We must be the first to {reach} the hoard and make sure the enemy doesn't get the information he needs.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_16:
I'd recommend to follow the few leads me and my associates could gather so far. ... \z
	Old myths, some {rumors} about old texts and other pieces of knowledge that I could use to figure out where to locate the hidden library and how to enter it.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_2: This leaves us with no choice but to take action into our own {hands}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_3: I guess you know about the {background} and there is no need to tell you that the forces from beyond managed to acquire the parts of the godbreaker in a coup.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_4: The secret locations of the godbreaker {parts} were revealed and due to trickery, the minions of Variphor aquired all of them.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_5: Those pieces of knowledge come in several forms and shapes. For most I can give you more or less specific hints where to start your {search}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_6: You have to {find} the veiled hoard of Zathroth, breach it and destroy the knowledge how to use the godbreaker.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_7:
The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ... \z
	Each part had to be crafted perfectly, to emulate the gods, so it would share 'the same place' with them. ... \z
	Mere mortals can not even perceive it in his whole but only recognize the part of it that is the physical representation in our world. ... \z
	If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ... \z
	However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_8:
The godbreaker is a complex artifact. Incantation woven into incantation. The powers bound into it are so immense that the slightest mishandling could prove disastrous. ... \z
	o figure out how it works, let alone how it can be operated safely, could require several centuries of tireless study. And even then this information would be only partial. ... \z
	Yet the creation and operation of the godbreaker is just the kind of forbidden {knowledge} Zathroth values most, so it was compiled and stored.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_9:
The myths agree that the place is well hidden, extremely guarded and contains some of the most powerful pieces of knowledge in this world and probably beyond. ... \z
	However the knowledge about the godbreaker now poses a threat to all existence. In the hands of Variphor it can cause disaster in previously unknown ways. The gods themselves are in {peril}.

npc.dixi.sendtrade_msg_1: Here, take a look and choose something nice for you!
npc.dixi.stdmod_1: <clears throat> Get your armor and shields heeeeeeere! Upstairs!
npc.dixi.stdmod_11: <giggles> I love gossiping - err, I mean providing valuable information of course, just tell me a name! <winks>
npc.dixi.stdmod_12: I'm helping my grandfather {Obi} with this shop. If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a {trade}!
npc.dixi.stdmod_14: You can deposit your {money} there to keep it safe. However, you still need cash to buy something here.
npc.dixi.stdmod_15: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
npc.dixi.stdmod_16: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you reach the {Island of Destiny}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_17: As a premium adventurer you can visit different regions on this island, trade with {Lee'Delle} and much more.
npc.dixi.stdmod_18: As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_19: If you need a torch, go see {Al Dee}'s store.
npc.dixi.stdmod_2: Need some help? Just ask me, I can show you around!
npc.dixi.stdmod_20: Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!
npc.dixi.stdmod_21: Are you hungry? Then you should visit {Willie} or {Billy} in the West of town. {Norma} also has yummy stuff! Oh, and you could pick {blueberries} or eat the food some {monsters} carry with them.
npc.dixi.stdmod_22: {Lily} sells effective health potions and antidote potions against poison.
npc.dixi.stdmod_23: The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymore} is the teacher there.
npc.dixi.stdmod_24: King Tibianus is a wise and noble monarch. This island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
npc.dixi.stdmod_25: Our lovely village will provide shelter for you. Once you are level 8, you can travel to {mainland} and choose a {profession}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_26: If you want to fight monsters in {dungeons}, you definitely need some good {equipment} such as a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_27: Just ask me for a {trade} to check out my offers.
npc.dixi.stdmod_28: Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.dixi.stdmod_29: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_3: Don't forget to protect yourself with a shield!
npc.dixi.stdmod_30: There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Just use them to your liking!
npc.dixi.stdmod_31: You need to make sure you have some basic {equipment} before you head into dungeons such as the {sewers}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_32: There is a sewer grate which you can use to enter the sewers just left of this building. Eww, this smell!
npc.dixi.stdmod_34: How can I help you? I can give you general {hints}, information about {citizens} or talk about many other topics. Just ask me!
npc.dixi.stdmod_35: I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!

npc.dixi.stdmod_37: Yes, I can sell that to you. Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.dixi.stdmod_38: Me and my grandfather {Obi} sell {equipment} of all kinds. Just ask him or me for a {trade} if you like to see our offers.
npc.dixi.stdmod_39: Norma used to sell {equipment}, but she finally earned enough {money} to fulfil one of her dreams - her own bar!
