npc.inkaef.say_1: So you ask me for a {{}} to begin your adventure?
npc.inkaef.say_2: What? I have already gave you one {{}}!
npc.iptar-sin.stdmod_1:
A blessed stake to defeat evil spirits? I do know an old prayer which is said to grant sacred power and to be able to bind this power to someone, or something. ... \z
	However, this prayer needs the combined energy of ten priests. Each of them has to say one line of the prayer. ... \z
	I could start with the prayer, but since the next priest has to be in a different location, you probably will have to travel a lot. ... \z
	Is this stake really important enough to you so that you are willing to take this burden?
npc.iptar-sin.stdmod_2:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.iptar_sin.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?
npc.iptar_sin.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_1: Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_11: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_14: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_16: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_18: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_19: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_2: I guess you couldn't convince Gamon to give you a stake, eh?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_20: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_21: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_22: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_23: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_24: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_25: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_26: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_27: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_28: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_29: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_3: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_30: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_4: So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_6: You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_7: You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_8: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_9: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.iptar_sin.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.irmana.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the house of fashion, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.ishebad.greet_msg_1: Be mourned, pilgrim in flesh. Are you looking for a promotion?
npc.ishebad.stdmod_1: Do you want to be promoted in your vocation for 20000 gold?
npc.ishina.greet_msg_1: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. Which of my fine gems do you {need}?
npc.ishina.stdmod_1: I am a jeweller. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful {offers}.
npc.ishina.stdmod_2: Well, I sell gems and {goblets}. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.ishina.stdmod_3: Ah, our newest import! We have golden goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.
npc.isimov.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.isimov.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.isimov.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.isimov.stdmod_11: I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, kid.
npc.isimov.stdmod_12: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.isimov.stdmod_13: So receive my prayer: 'Unclean spirits shall be repelled'. Now, bring your stake to Amanda in Edron for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.isimov.stdmod_15: You should visit Amanda in Edron now, kid.
npc.isimov.stdmod_16: You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.isimov.stdmod_17: A blessed stake? That's a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.isimov.stdmod_18: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.isimov.stdmod_19: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.isimov.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.isimov.stdmod_20: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.isimov.stdmod_21: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.isimov.stdmod_22: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.isimov.stdmod_23: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.isimov.stdmod_24: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.isimov.stdmod_25: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.isimov.stdmod_26: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.isimov.stdmod_27: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.isimov.stdmod_28: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.isimov.stdmod_29: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.isimov.stdmod_30: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.isimov.stdmod_32:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.isimov.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.isimov.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.isimov.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.isimov.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.iskan.greet_msg_1: You are not one of us. I don't want to talk to you.
npc.iskan.greet_msg_2: I was told you have been killing huskies here in Svargrond! Never do that again, okay? They are precious animals for us. Give me 500 gold and I will forget that incident without telling it to Jarl Sven. Okay?
npc.iskan.greet_msg_3: HAIL to the Warlord of the arena! |PLAYERNAME|, Hero of Svargrond! What can I {do for you}?
npc.iskan.greet_msg_4: Greetings. What can I {do for you}?
npc.iskan.stdmod_1: I run the dog sled service from this city to {Nibelor}.
npc.iskan.stdmod_10: The yeti is real and dangerous.
npc.iskan.stdmod_11: I am not sure what to think about this new custom to accept foreigners as one of us after passing that test. But it's the Jarl's decision, not mine.
npc.iskan.stdmod_12: The raiders camps are far to the south. There are three of them. Small camp sites of raiding parties might be found almost anywhere though.
npc.iskan.stdmod_13: They are sometimes trying to catch me and the boys. Such fools, they will never get us. Right, boys?
npc.iskan.stdmod_14: The boys can tell who's an enemy just by the smell.
npc.iskan.stdmod_15: Me and the boys care only about our own territory.
npc.iskan.stdmod_16: I guess their healing powers are almost as useful as those of our shamans.
npc.iskan.stdmod_17: I guess there are guys like me that have a talent to talk to dogs and there are guys like the shamans that have the talent to talk to spirits.
npc.iskan.stdmod_18: We don't need any kings or queens. Am I right, boys? Yeah, I am.
npc.iskan.stdmod_19: Sven the Younger is our current Jarl. For my standards he's still a puppy, but a smart one at least.
npc.iskan.stdmod_20: Yeah, where could it be. That's the question.
npc.iskan.stdmod_21: Easy, boys! Don't mention that name again. Makes the boys nuts, ye know?
npc.iskan.stdmod_22: In my whole long life, I've not seen any sign of those gods the people of the south are constantly talking about.
npc.iskan.stdmod_23: The icy father. We know him all too well, am I right boys? He has claimed so many old friends in all those years. So many.
npc.iskan.stdmod_24:
I'll tell you something. I have seen such a creature once, far on the ice to the east. It was the coldest winter I can remember and the chakoyas were roaming the ice almost everywhere. ... \z
	To evade them, me and the boys had to walk a long way to a spot where the ice was treacherous and thin. ... \z
	And there I've seen such a creature. The boys went almost mad and I turned my sled immediately. No idea how we made it home. True story.
npc.iskan.stdmod_3: I can bring you to Nibelor with the sled if you want to. Just ask for a {passage}.
npc.iskan.stdmod_4: This city seems to be growing every day. First, there have been only a few huts and now ... look around, houses everywhere.
npc.iskan.stdmod_5: Our people are very proud and honest. I guess that's more than most people can say about themselves and their people, right boys?
npc.iskan.stdmod_6: I heard something about a ship crashing in the shelf ice between Nibelor and Grimlund. If I were you, I wouldn't go to chakoya terrain. It's pretty dangerous.
npc.iskan.stdmod_7: Nasty little beasts. Me and the boys had quite some bloody encounters with them on the ice.
npc.iskan.stdmod_8: The boys warn me in advance if a monster is around.
npc.iskan.stdmod_9: My boys did not like the guys that were travelling through our city, and I trust in their instincts. Isn't it so, boys?
npc.ivalisse.greet_msg_1: Hello, worshiper of the Astral Shapers! Welcome to the temple! While you are here to pay tribute, you can also learn something about the ancient art of imbuing.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_1: My {father}, can you tell me if he's alright?
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_2: Alright then, you are very welcome to explore the temple!
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_4: There is always time to make a change.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_5: Besides my various {duties} in the temple, I also take care of visitors. Well, I would but right now I can't get my mind of how my {father}'s doing. I am sorry.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_6: I help linking the portals of this temple to other ancient sites of the {Astral Shapers}.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_7: I help linking the portals of this temple to other ancient sites of the {Astral Shapers}.
npc.iwan.greet_msg_1: Feel welcome to my gem store, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.iwan.voice_1: Gems of all kinds! Precious jewellery!
npc.iwar.greet_msg_1: Hiho Storm Killer! Welcome to Kazordoon furniture store.
npc.iyad.farewell_msg_1: D...Daraman's blessings... oh, how I m...miss my warm Darashia...
npc.iyad.greet_msg_1: Finally! A c...c...customer! Wh... where do you want to f...f...{fly}?
npc.iyad.stdmod_1: A... aargh. I wish I had some e... earmuffs to put over this useless t... turban.
npc.iyad.stdmod_10: I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Edron}, to {Kazordoon}, to Z... Zao, to the F...{Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to M... {Marapur} if you like. W....Where do you want to go?
npc.iyad.stdmod_11: I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Edron}, to {Kazordoon}, to Z... Zao, to the F...{Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to M... {Marapur} if you like. W....Where do you want to go?
npc.iyad.stdmod_12: I'm k...known as Iyad Ibn Abdul.
npc.iyad.stdmod_13: The thought of s...some mad sorcerer unleashing some f...fire magic is very tempting.
npc.iyad.stdmod_14: S...so close and s...still that far away.
npc.iyad.stdmod_15: For all its m...mistakes, Thais is warm at least.
npc.iyad.stdmod_16: I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Edron}, to {Kazordoon}, to Z... Zao, to the F...{Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to M... {Marapur} if you like. W....Where do you want to go?
npc.iyad.stdmod_17: I would t...trade it for some firewood.
npc.iyad.stdmod_18: This h...here is no continent. This is h...hell.
npc.iyad.stdmod_19: Even D...Drefia can't be worse than this land.
npc.iyad.stdmod_20: I d...don't care about any n...news unless it's the announcement of a h....heatwave.
npc.iyad.stdmod_3: Never heard about a place like this.
npc.iyad.stdmod_4: Do you seek a ride to {0} for {1}?
npc.iyad.stdmod_7: I'm a licensed c...carpet pilot. I can {transport} you t...to a warm p...place.
npc.iyad.stdmod_8: I t...{transport} travellers to the continent of Darama for a small fee. It's w...warm there.
npc.iyad.stdmod_9: I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Edron}, to {Kazordoon}, to Z... Zao, to the F...{Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to M... {Marapur} if you like. W....Where do you want to go?
npc.iyad.voice_1: A... aargh. I wish I had some e... earmuffs to put over this useless t... turban.
npc.iyad.voice_2: Oh p.. please. P... lease let me fly us out of this c... cold.
npc.jack.greet_msg_1: You!! What have you told my family? They are mad at me and I don't even know why! They think I lied to them about working in Edron in secrecy! Why should I even do that!
npc.jack.greet_msg_2: So, you've returned to Spectulus? What did he say, is anything wrong? You have this strange expression on your face - is there anything wrong? You DID tell me the truth here, didn't you?
npc.jack.greet_msg_3: Yes? What can I do for you? I hope this won't take long, though.
npc.jack.greet_msg_4: What did you do to my SCULPTURE? You simply DESTROYED it? Why? You... you ruined everything... my house, my hobby, my life. My family even refuses to talk to me anymore. ...
npc.jack.greet_msg_5: Alright, alright you win. I am done for. You... you must be right, yes. Yes, I was working as an intern... in the academy in Edron... yes... Just... tell this Spectulus guy I want to see him. I have nothing left. I am ready.
npc.jack.say_1: So it's that name again. You are really determined, aren't you. ...
npc.jack.say_2: So if he thinks I'm someone he knew who is now 'lost' and needs to come back or whatever - tell him he is WRONG. I always lived here with my mother and sister, I'm happy here and I certainly don't want to go to that academy of yours.
npc.jack.voice_1: Now I need to clean up everything again.
npc.jack.voice_2: So much to do, so little time, they say...
npc.jack.voice_3: Could it be...? No. No way.
npc.jack_drone.farewell_msg_1: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
npc.jack_drone.greet_msg_1: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today? I can travel you back to {thais}.
npc.jack_drone.stdmod_1: Do you seek a passage back to thais?
npc.jack_drone.stdmod_2: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.jack_fate.farewell_msg_1: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.

npc.jack_fate.stdmod_10: Where do you want to go? To {Edron}, {Thais}, {Venore}, {Darashia}, {Ankrahmun}, {Yalahar} or {Port Hope}?
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_11: My name is Jack Fate from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_12: I'm the captain of this sailing ship.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_13: I'm the captain of this sailing ship.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_2: I'm sorry but I don't sail there.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_3: Never heard about a place like this.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_4: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_5: Do you seek a passage to Thais for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_6: I have to warn you - we might get into a tropical storm on that route. I'm not sure if my ship will withstand it. Do you really want to travel to Thais?
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_7: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_8: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_9: Where do you want to go? To {Edron}, {Thais}, {Venore}, {Darashia}, {Ankrahmun}, {Yalahar} or {Port Hope}?
npc.jack_fate.voice_1: Passages to Edron, Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Yalahar and Port Hope.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.greet_msg_1: Hello, Sir |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_1: My name is Jack Fate from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_2: I'm the captain of this - well, wreck. Argh.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_3: I'm the captain of this - well, wreck. Argh
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_4: This is where we are... the volcano island Goroma. There are many rumours about this place.
npc.jack_springer.greet_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! There is much we have to {discuss}.
npc.jack_springer.greet_msg_2: Hello, stranger! You look suspicious to me. I don't think we have anything to discuss.
npc.jack_springer.greet_msg_4: Hello, stranger! Sorry, but I never heard about you. I'm looking for more experienced help.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_10: Here is where you come into play. We could identify the most recent plot of the Shiron'Fal and already had some {clashes}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_11: In our efforts to hinder their plot, we achieved mixed results at best. But now things are escalating fast and we have to {hurry}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_12: Our resources are already stretched thin, so we need your help with the most recent {problem}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_13: The legion tries to use a new form of twisted rituals to raise the bodies of well-known {knights}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_14: These powerful undead were a terrible threat on their own but it seems even they are just part of some larger {scheme} that we cannot make out yet.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_15: We are still working feverishly to uncover their goals but for now more imminent {threats} are at hand.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_18:
For this purpose, the members gather knowledge, artefacts and powerful individuals. The members are formidable at certain fields of expertise. They are cunning and powerful and act with no regard for others, with no remorse or mercy. ... \z
	As they are doing this since ages, they must have acquired tremendous powers and knowledge. Their members often operate alone but are usually well funded with the necessary resources. ... \z
	Whatever their endgame might be, each of their operations pose a grave danger to the whole world and have to be {stopped}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_19:
Reaching the graves will not be without danger and if you encounter the death cultists you will have to fight them. Even worse, they might have even succeeded in some cases. ... \z
	As a newly risen lich-knight is not able to leave the site of its resurrection for some time, you might have to fight some of them. ... \z
	Let us pray that you never come too {late} or else some of the fiends might be able to leave their crypts.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_20:
We have located twelve graves that have to be secured: In the old northern Edron graveyard, in the dark cathedral of the plains of havoc, in the ghostlands, on Cormaya, Somewhere in the Femor Hills, on Vengoth, ... \z
	in the graveyard of Darashia, in the old temple north of Thais, at the entrance to the orcland, one is on the southern ice islands, in a mountain on Kilmaresh, one on an island north-east of Ankrahmun.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_21:
Well, in Rathleton there was an individual at work, looking for some ancient artefact of power. ... \z
	To cover its escape the creature left another creature, known as the ravager to cover his tracks. But there is {more}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_22:
Only recently someone was trying to manipulate the elven dream courts into releasing a monstrosity of nightmares, probably planning to control or recruit this creature. .... \z
	But those incidents were just some of {many}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_23:
There is a scheming going on behind the scenes. Powerful good people were corrupted. Evil-doers got backup and resources from a hidden ally. ... \z
	Powerful malignant creatures, gathering their kind under their banner and so much more. These things are not happening by chance. There is a pattern, a guiding {hand}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_24:
It has a rather complex meaning and as far as we can tell it translates to 'army of those who are many, dedicated to the ultimate time of mayhem and despair'. ... \z
	Other, more handy names are army of the last battlefield, army of the last days, legion of mayhem, dread legion or simply the {legion}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_25:
We know little for sure. You can look into our books to see some of our sources. But most are vague and some even contradictory. ... \z
	To summarise what we know, let me tell you this: The Shiron'Fal is an extremely old organisation. It seeks to accumulate power for some unknown but certainly sinister {goal}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_26:
The knights they aim at were tainted in life by their actions or happenstance. ... \z
	This leaves their bodies vulnerable to their special breed of necromancy that would raise them as powerful {lich}-knights.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_3: I need your help in a matter of utmost {urgency}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_4: The situation is complicated and it's even hard to say where to {start} best, just to describe it to you.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_5: You see, several incidents in history can be traced back to a single {source}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_6: Things get murkier the further you go down in history, but that's not even necessary. Even today we can discern a certain pattern in recent {events}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_7: The recent rise of lycanthropy, the robbery of certain forbidden arcane texts and the vanishing of at least three dangerous individuals, targeted by the inquisition are just the tip of the {iceberg}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_8: This outside force is moving behind the scenes since ages. Our research suggests that this force probably even {predates} the rise of humanity.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_9: Well, we are sure that the puppeteer behind all these events is an organisation. So old that even its name, the Shiron'Fal, has lost its meaning, because the {language} it originates from is long dead.
npc.jakahr.farewell_msg_1: It was an honour to serve you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.jakahr.greet_msg_1: Hello, mourned pilgrim. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.jakahr.sendtrade_msg_1: Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
npc.jakahr.walkaway_msg_1: It was an honour to serve you.
npc.jamesfrancis.greet_msg_1: Gerimor is right. As an expert for minotaurs I am researching these creatures for years. I thought I already knew a lot but the monsters in this cave are {different}. It's a big {mystery}.
npc.jamesfrancis.greet_msg_3: You say the minotaurs were controlled by a very powerful boss they worshipped. This explains why they had so much more power than the normal ones. ...
npc.jamesfrancis.greet_msg_4: I'm very thankful. Please go to the Druid of Crunor and tell him what you've seen. He might be interested in that.
npc.jamesfrancis.voice_1: Don't enter this area if you are an inexperienced fighter! It would be your end!
npc.jean_pierre.greet_msg_1: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. What are you doing out here?
npc.jefrey.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.jefrey.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.jerom.greet_msg_1: Hello. Sorry, but I'm not in the best {mood} today.
npc.jerom.stdmod_10: I like it here, at least the town. I was warned that there are nasty creatures outside the town walls but I didn't expect anything to happen so close to town!
npc.jerom.stdmod_11: I was always good with animals. My parents had a farm, the McRonalds farm. Maybe you know it. Anyway, I had the idea that people may like to have animals as companions and so one led to another.
npc.jerom.stdmod_12: I'd go mad listening to this 'ribbit' the whole time. But each to his own!
npc.jerom.stdmod_13: I'm new here in Edron. I wanted to open up a pet shop. But now I'm ruined, uahahahaha <sniffs>.
npc.jerom.stdmod_14: I need to write a letter to the king. I'm not sure if those 2 million gold coins that Daniel Steelsoul demanded from me weren't too much.
npc.jerom.stdmod_15: I'm there from time to time, catching frogs. People like their bright colours.
npc.jerom.stdmod_16: My name is Jerom but no need to remember my name. All my belongings are destroyed and stolen. I'll be gone soon!
npc.jerom.stdmod_17: Raymond Striker offered me a contract to export parrots from Meriana but I won't need them anymore now that I'm ruined.
npc.jerom.stdmod_18: Not a very good spot to catch animals. At least no animals that pass off as pets.
npc.jerom.stdmod_19: Yesterday I would have said that I like all creatures of Tibia but TODAY my life has changed! When I catch this stinking troll!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_2: Dear gods! My precious house, DESTROYED!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_20: True, why not keep a rat as a pet! They can eat your trash, live inside your walls and you don't have to worry if one dies ! Could be a huge success....if I weren't ruined!!!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_21: That would be a mission for a hero.
npc.jerom.stdmod_22: Well, I don't see any other way than going back to my home country now.
npc.jerom.stdmod_23: Good idea! Easy to catch and once the owner has been bitten, he can't sue me anymore, hehehe!!.... but wait....I forgot....I'm ruined, uahahahaha <sniffs>.
npc.jerom.stdmod_24: I never make profit in Thais and most of the time I get robbed. I stopped visiting Thais for business some years ago.
npc.jerom.stdmod_3: Oh no!! What am I supposed to do now?!?
npc.jerom.stdmod_4: The only animal to catch there is the cobra and most people don't like to keep one as a pet.
npc.jerom.stdmod_5: Who wants such an animal as a pet?!?!
npc.jerom.stdmod_6: Those amazons denied making business with me. You know the reason?!? I tell you, the reason was that I am MALE! Ridiculous!
npc.jerom.stdmod_7: For sure, I would have offered cats!
npc.jerom.stdmod_8: He gave me the permission to open up a pet shop here. I paid him almost everything I got!
npc.jerom.stdmod_9: I made contact with Svargrond! A guy named Buddel wanted to sell me a three-headed dog. I haven't seen it yet, but imagine how much money I could make by breeding such a pet!!
npc.jerom.voice_2: Dear gods! My precious house, DESTROYED!!
npc.jerom.voice_3: Oh no!! What am I supposed to do now?!?
npc.jeronimo.voice_1: Change your Bar of Gold's for Items here!
npc.jessica.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.jessica.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.jezzara.greet_msg_1: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. Talking of flesh, maybe you'd enjoy some {food}?
npc.jezzara.sendtrade_msg_1: Sure, take a look at my offers.
npc.jezzara.voice_1: Food of various kinds, have a look.
npc.jorge.say_1: You just swapped 20 silver raid tokens for 1 {}.
npc.julius.greet_msg_1: Be greeted, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. I assume you have read the {note} about the {vampire} threat in this city.
npc.julius.greet_msg_2: Be greeted, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. Please excuse me if I appear {distracted}!
npc.julius.sendtrade_msg_1: I'll reward you for every pair of vampire teeth you bring me.
npc.julius.stdmod_1: I come from a family of {vampire} hunters, but to be honest, I'm more into the theoretic part and strategic planning.
npc.julius.stdmod_2: A better name would be Gomorrah, if you ask me.
npc.julius.stdmod_4: Storkus? Oh yes, I know him. A long time ago we used to hunt together... sometimes.
npc.julius.stdmod_5: It's about time you showed the vampires that they should never bother the citizens again.
npc.julius.stdmod_6: Another vampire raid last night. But then again, that's nothing new.
npc.julius.stdmod_7: Well, I should be the one to thank you I guess.

npc.kais.stdmod_1: I have the power to grant you the blood of the mountain's blessing. But I must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you prepared for that?
npc.kais.stdmod_10: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kais.stdmod_11: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.

npc.kais.stdmod_7: Well, as I am quite in a fix currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.

There are also five different other blessings available, each in a sacred place. ...\nThese blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.

npc.kawill.stdmod_1: The Spark of the Phoenix is given by me and by the great pyromancer in the nearby fire temple. Do you wish to receive my part of the Spark of the Phoenix?
npc.kawill.stdmod_10: Nice world in general. It's a shame there is so much water ruining the general impression.
npc.kawill.stdmod_12: May the earth swallow them all!
npc.kawill.stdmod_13: Ah, a weapon to be feared by man, beast and god alike, jawoll. He who wields it will be both blessed and cursed at the same time.
npc.kawill.stdmod_14: The day will come when he finally bites the dust.
npc.kawill.stdmod_15: By using the powers of fire and earth we forced the river that once wound its way through the big old one in other directions, and created our home.
npc.kawill.stdmod_16: Bezil and Nezil have pawn and equpiment shop with an amazing stock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_17: Bezil and Nezil have pawn and equpiment shop with an amazing stock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_18: The first knight of dwarvenkind is a fine woman.
npc.kawill.stdmod_19: I fear the sorcerers focus on the destructive forces of fire. They forget about the protection earth could provide.
npc.kawill.stdmod_2: So receive the blessing of the life-giving earth, pilgrim.
npc.kawill.stdmod_20: He is a jolly fellow and one of the oldest dwarves alive.
npc.kawill.stdmod_21: He is a fine smith and his armour may save your neck one day.
npc.kawill.stdmod_22: She is a fine cook, jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_23: Uzgod is a blacksmith and understands the ways of his element well.
npc.kawill.stdmod_24: The emperor has rarely visited the temple district in the last years. He should care more about spirituality then about politics. Jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_25: The emperor has rarely visited the temple district in the last years. He should care more about spirituality then about politics. Jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_26: The celestial paladin, the protector of our race. The only divine being we care for and the only one who still cares for dwarfs.
npc.kawill.stdmod_27: Where earth is giving, fire is taking. That is the way of the elements.
npc.kawill.stdmod_28: The lifegiving earth protects us, feeds us and takes us home after death.
npc.kawill.stdmod_29: The mountain we live in is called the big old one. It's the mountain of mountains, and it isand like a friend and protector to our race.
npc.kawill.stdmod_3: Ok. If you don't want it...
npc.kawill.stdmod_4: The gods are treacherous and vain. They want to use us like they did in the past. Only the elements can be trusted, because all they want is for nature to run its set course.
npc.kawill.stdmod_5: I am the great geomancer of dwarvenkind.
npc.kawill.stdmod_6: We investigate the will of the earth. It is our duty to make sure things to work in their natural way.
npc.kawill.stdmod_7: Life is born by earth and fed by earth.
npc.kawill.stdmod_8: I am Kawill Marbleeye, Son of Earth, from the Molten Rock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_9: There's nothing I need, better ask others.
npc.kawill.walkaway_msg_1: Earth under your feet, pilgrim. What brings you here?

npc.king_tibianus.greet_2: I greet thee, my loyal subject |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_1: I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_10: The latest news is usually brought to our magnificent town by brave adventurers. They recount tales of their journeys at Frodo's tavern.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_13: Sell? Sell what? My kingdom isn't for sale!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_14: Honour the Gods and above all pay your {taxes}.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_15: Please ask a priest about the gods.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_16: The citizens of Tibia are my subjects. Ask the old monk Quentin if you want to learn more about them.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_17: He is a skilled blacksmith and a loyal subject.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_18: He is the owner of Frodo's Hut and a faithful tax-payer.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_19: He was once one of Tibia's greatest fighters. Now he sells equipment.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_20: He was once my greatest general. Now he is very old and senile so we assigned him to work for the Royal Tibia Mail.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_21: The royal poodle Noodles is my greatest {treasure}!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_22: He is a follower of the evil God Zathroth and responsible for many attacks on us. Kill him on sight!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_23: He is my royal jester and cheers me up now and then.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_24: The royal poodle Noodles is my greatest treasure!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_25: Go and hunt them! For king and country!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_26: Visit Quentin the monk for help.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_28: Dungeons are no places for kings.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_29: Feel free to buy it in our town's fine shops.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_3: Alright then, come back when you are ready.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_30: Ask the royal cook for some food.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_31: That tax collector is the bane of my life. He is so lazy. I bet you haven't payed any taxes at all.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_32: I am the king, so watch what you say!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_34: Visit the shops of our merchants and craftsmen.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_35: The four major guilds are the knights, the paladins, the druids, and the sorcerers.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_36: Vile monsters, but I must admit they are strong and sometimes even cunning ... in their own bestial way.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_37: The forces of good are hard pressed in these dark times.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_38: We need all strength we can muster to smite evil!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_4: It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_41: It's the sword of the Kings. If you return this weapon to me I will {reward} you beyond your wildest dreams.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_42: Well, if you want a reward, go on a quest to bring me Excalibug!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_43: A very competent person. A little nervous but very competent.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_44: This organisation is an essential tool for holding our enemies in check. Its headquarter is located in the bastion in the northwall.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_45: Soon the whole land will be ruled by me once again!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_46: Harkath Bloodblade is the general of our glorious {army}.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_47: I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again and then reward them appropriately.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_48: To pay your taxes, visit the royal tax collector.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_5: Awesome! Please pay a visit to www.otserv.com.br!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_50: Our enemies are numerous. The evil minotaurs, Ferumbras, and the renegade city of Carlin to the north are just some of them.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_51: They dare to reject my reign over the whole continent!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_52: Our beloved city has some fine shops, guildhouses and a modern sewerage system.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_54: The paladins are great protectors for Thais.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_55: The brave knights are necessary for human survival in Thais.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_56: The magic of the sorcerers is a powerful tool to smite our enemies.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_6: Baah is awesome dude that rewrote my outfit script.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_7: I am your sovereign, King Tibianus III, and it's my duty to uphold {justice} and provide guidance for my subjects.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_8: I try my best to be just and fair to our citizens. The army and the {TBI} are a great help in fulfilling this duty.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_9: Preposterous! You must know the name of your own King!

npc.klom_stonecutter.greet_msg_1: Greetings. A warning straight ahead: I don't like loiterin'. If you're not here to {help} us, you're here to waste my time. Which I consider loiterin'. Now, try and prove your {worth} to our alliance. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.greet_msg_2: I have sealed some of the areas far too dangerous for anyone to enter. If you can prove you're capable, you'll get an opportunity to help destroy the weird machines, pumping lava into the caves leading to the most dangerous enemies.
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_1: We need to find a way to drive off the exiles from these caves. Countless makeshift homes are popping up at every corner. Destroy them and get the Lost out of hiding to eliminate them. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_10: Prepared to get rid of some seriously foul creepers for us?
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_2: If you can capture a few of them, you'll receive a bonus. Just bring 'em to the border of our outpost and we will take care of the rest. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_4: We need to find a way to drive off the exiles from these caves. Countless makeshift homes are popping up at every corner. Destroy them and get the Lost out of hiding to eliminate them. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_5: If you can capture a few of them, you'll receive a bonus. Just bring 'em to the border of our outpost and we will take care of the rest. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_7: Vermin. Everywhere. We get a lot of strange four-legged crawlers and worms down here lately. It's getting out of hand and... well, I need a real killer for this.
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_8: Prepared to get rid of some seriously foul creepers for us?

npc.klom_stonecutter.say_1: You want to offer {} suspicious device{}. Which leader shall have it, (Gnomus) of the {gnomes}, (Klom Stonecutter) of the {dwarves} or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_10: If you bring me any suspicious devices on creatures you slay down here, I'll make it worth your while by telling the others of your generosity. How many do you want to offer?
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_13: You don't have enough suspicious devices.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_15: You don't have enough suspicious devices.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_17: You don't have enough suspicious devices.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_18: So you want to know what we all think about your deeds? What leader's opinion are you interested in, the {gnomes} (Gnomus), the {dwarves} (Klom Stonecutter) or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_2: The gnomes are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_3: The dwarves are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_4: The scouts are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_5: I don't need your help for now. Come back later.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_6: Come back when you have finished your job.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_7: So you did it. Well, that won't be the last of 'em but this sure helps our situation down here. Return to me later if you want to help me again!
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_8: So you did it. And you even made prisoners, the bonus is yours! Well, that won't be the last of 'em but this sure helps our situation down here. Return to me later if you want to help me again!
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_9: Very well, now try to find some of their makeshift homes and tear'em down. There's bound to be some stragglers you can 'persuade' to surrender, eliminate any resistance. Get back here when you're done.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_1: Well, the biggest problem we need to address are the ever charging {subterraneans} around here. And on top of that, there's the threat of the Lost, who quite made themselves at {home} in these parts.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_7:
The attacks of the enemy forces are fierce but we hold our ground. ...  \z
	I'd love to face one of their generals in combat but as their masters they cowardly hide far behind enemy lines and I have other duties to fulfil. ...  \z
	I envy you for the chance to thrust into the heart of the enemy, locking weapons with their jaws... or whatever... and see the fear in their eyes when they recognise they were bested.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_8:
I welcome a fine battle as any dwarf worth his beard should do. As long as it's a battle against something I can hit with my trusty axe. ... \z
	But here the true {enemy} eludes us. We fight wave after wave of their lackeys and if the gnomes are right the true enemy is up to something far more sinister.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_9:
I have no idea what kind of creeps are behind all this. Even the gnomes don't and they have handled that stuff way more often. ... \z
	But even if we knew nothing more about them, the fact alone that they employ the help of those mockeries of all things dwarfish, marks them as an enemy of the dwarves and it's our obligation to annihilate them.
